```{r hr-processing, echo=FALSE}
hr_exclude <- c(
  "TAG313p2_20191117_151413",   # duplicate session
  "TAG077_20190823_145422",     # artifact: impossibly low task HR
  "TAG188_20190731_145115"      # artifact: impossibly low task HR
)

hr_resting1 <- hr_resting1_raw |> rename(id = 1) |> filter(!id %in% hr_exclude) |> mutate(sequence = "Resting 1")
hr_resting2 <- hr_resting2_raw |> rename(id = 1) |> filter(!id %in% hr_exclude) |> mutate(sequence = "Resting 2")
hr_task      <- hr_task_raw    |> rename(id = 1) |> filter(!id %in% hr_exclude) |> mutate(sequence = "Task")

hr_all_wide <- bind_rows(hr_resting1, hr_resting2, hr_task) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = sequence, values_from = Mean_HR) |>
  mutate(resting_avg = if_else(is.na(`Resting 2`), `Resting 1`, (`Resting 1` + `Resting 2`) / 2))

hr_conditions_avg <- hr_conditions_raw |>
  pivot_longer(SOS068_20190303_150846:TAG223_20191116_145342, names_to = "id", values_to = "hr") |>
  rename(task_condition = Task_condition) |>
  group_by(id, task_condition) |>
  summarise(mean_hr = mean(hr, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  filter(!is.na(task_condition), task_condition != "NA") |>
  mutate(task_condition = factor(task_condition,
    levels = c("1", "2", "3", "R"),
    labels = c("Other", "Self-Disconnected", "Self-Connected", "Fixation-Cross")
  )) |>
  filter(!id %in% hr_exclude)

pull_hr <- function(cond) filter(hr_conditions_avg, task_condition == cond)$mean_hr

make_box_stats <- function(data, col) {
  function(y, ...) {
    m <- mean(y, na.rm = TRUE)
    data.frame(
      y     = m + 0.08,
      label = paste0("M = ", round(m, 2))
    )
  }
}
```

```{r hr-difference, echo=FALSE}
hr_final_wide <- hr_all_wide |>
  full_join(
    hr_conditions_avg |> pivot_wider(names_from = task_condition, values_from = mean_hr),
    by = "id"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    SampleID = case_when(
      str_sub(id, 1, 6) == "SOS068" ~ "TAG068",
      str_sub(id, 1, 6) == "SOS076" ~ "TAG076",
      .default = str_sub(id, 1, 6)
    ),
    task_rs_hr_diff    = Task - resting_avg,
    conn_dis_hr_diff   = `Self-Connected` - `Self-Disconnected`,
    conn_other_hr_diff = `Self-Connected` - Other,
    conn_rest_hr_diff  = `Self-Connected` - `Fixation-Cross`
  )

hr_difference <- hr_final_wide |>
  select(SampleID, task_rs_hr_diff, conn_dis_hr_diff, conn_other_hr_diff, conn_rest_hr_diff)
```

```{r biomarker-processing, echo=FALSE}
sos_crp_panel       <- sos_crp       |> select(SampleID, Time, CRP_log)
sos_cytokines_panel <- sos_cytokines |> select(SampleID, Time, IL10_log, IL6_log, TNFalpha_log)
sos_hormones_panel  <- sos_hormones  |> select(SampleID, Time, DHEA_log, Testosterone_log, Cortisol_log)

run_mlm <- function(outcome, data) {
  f_lin  <- as.formula(paste(outcome, "~ 1 + Time + (1 + Time | SampleID)"))
  f_quad <- as.formula(paste(outcome, "~ 1 + poly(Time, 2) + (1 + poly(Time, 2) | SampleID)"))
  mlm_lin  <- lmer(f_lin,  na.action = na.omit, REML = TRUE, data = data)
  mlm_quad <- lmer(f_quad, na.action = na.omit, REML = TRUE, data = data)
  list(linear = mlm_lin, quadratic = mlm_quad, aic = AIC(mlm_lin, mlm_quad), bic = BIC(mlm_lin, mlm_quad))
}

mlm_crp      <- run_mlm("CRP_log",          sos_crp_panel)
mlm_il10     <- run_mlm("IL10_log",         sos_cytokines_panel)
mlm_il6      <- run_mlm("IL6_log",          sos_cytokines_panel)
mlm_tnfalpha <- run_mlm("TNFalpha_log",     sos_cytokines_panel)
mlm_dhea     <- run_mlm("DHEA_log",         sos_hormones_panel)
mlm_test     <- run_mlm("Testosterone_log", sos_hormones_panel)
mlm_cort     <- run_mlm("Cortisol_log",     sos_hormones_panel)
```

```{r peaks-processing, echo=FALSE}
sos_crp_wide <- sos_crp_panel |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Time,
    values_from = CRP_log,
    names_glue = "CRP_log_{Time}",
    values_fn = mean
  ) |>
  mutate(crp_peak = if_else(CRP_log_3 > CRP_log_4, CRP_log_3, CRP_log_4))

sos_cytokines_wide <- sos_cytokines_panel |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Time,
    values_from = c(IL10_log, IL6_log, TNFalpha_log),
    values_fn = mean
  ) |>
  mutate(
    il10_peak = if_else(IL10_log_3 > IL10_log_4, IL10_log_3, IL10_log_4),
    il6_peak = if_else(IL6_log_3 > IL6_log_4, IL6_log_3, IL6_log_4),
    tnfa_peak = if_else(
      TNFalpha_log_3 > TNFalpha_log_4,
      TNFalpha_log_3,
      TNFalpha_log_4
    )
  )

sos_hormones_wide <- sos_hormones_panel |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Time,
    values_from = c(DHEA_log, Testosterone_log, Cortisol_log),
    values_fn = mean
  ) |>
  mutate(
    dhea_peak = if_else(DHEA_log_3 > DHEA_log_4, DHEA_log_3, DHEA_log_4),
    test_peak = if_else(
      Testosterone_log_3 > Testosterone_log_4,
      Testosterone_log_3,
      Testosterone_log_4
    ),
    cort_peak = if_else(
      Cortisol_log_3 > Cortisol_log_4,
      Cortisol_log_3,
      Cortisol_log_4
    )
  )

make_peak_long <- function(wide_data, t1_col, peak_col, value_name) {
  wide_data |>
    select(SampleID, all_of(c(t1_col, peak_col))) |>
    pivot_longer(
      all_of(c(t1_col, peak_col)),
      names_to = "time_point",
      values_to = value_name
    ) |>
    mutate(
      time_point = factor(
        time_point,
        levels = c(t1_col, peak_col),
        labels = c("T1", "T3/T4 peak")
      )
    )
}

fmt_p_fdr   <- function(p) {
  if (p < 0.001) "p[FDR] < 0.001" else paste0("p[FDR] == ", round(p, 4))
}
fmt_p_plain <- function(p) {
  if (p < 0.001) "p < 0.001" else sprintf("p = %.3f", p)
}

biomarker_plot <- function(data, y_col, y_label, p_fdr) {
  ggplot(data, aes(x = time_point, y = .data[[y_col]])) +
    stat_halfeye(
      aes(fill = time_point),
      adjust = 0.5,
      width = 0.6,
      .width = 0,
      justification = -0.2,
      point_colour = NA,
      alpha = 0.8
    ) +
    geom_boxplot(
      width = 0.15,
      outlier.shape = NA,
      color = "gray30",
      linewidth = 0.5
    ) +
    geom_point(
      aes(color = time_point),
      position = position_jitter(seed = 1, width = 0.1),
      size = 1.2,
      alpha = 0.3
    ) +
    scale_fill_viridis_d() +
    scale_color_viridis_d(guide = "none") +
    geom_signif(
      comparisons = list(c("T1", "T3/T4 peak")),
      annotations = fmt_p_fdr(p_fdr),
      textsize = 3.5,
      vjust = 0.1,
      tip_length = 0.02,
      parse = TRUE
    ) +
    ylab(y_label) +
    xlab(NULL) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(legend.position = "none",
          plot.margin = margin(t = 20, r = 5, b = 5, l = 5))
}

sos_crp_long <- make_peak_long(
  sos_crp_wide,
  "CRP_log_1",
  "crp_peak",
  "crp_log_conc"
)
sos_il10_long <- make_peak_long(
  sos_cytokines_wide,
  "IL10_log_1",
  "il10_peak",
  "il10_log_conc"
)
sos_il6_long <- make_peak_long(
  sos_cytokines_wide,
  "IL6_log_1",
  "il6_peak",
  "il6_log_conc"
)
sos_tnfa_long <- make_peak_long(
  sos_cytokines_wide,
  "TNFalpha_log_1",
  "tnfa_peak",
  "tnfa_log_conc"
)
sos_dhea_long <- make_peak_long(
  sos_hormones_wide,
  "DHEA_log_1",
  "dhea_peak",
  "dhea_log_conc"
)
sos_test_long <- make_peak_long(
  sos_hormones_wide,
  "Testosterone_log_1",
  "test_peak",
  "test_log_conc"
)
sos_cort_long <- make_peak_long(
  sos_hormones_wide,
  "Cortisol_log_1",
  "cort_peak",
  "cort_log_conc"
)

run_peak_test <- function(peak_col, t1_col, data) {
  t.test(
    data[[peak_col]],
    data[[t1_col]],
    alternative = "greater",
    paired = TRUE
  )
}

crp_difference <- sos_crp_wide |>
  mutate(crp_difference = crp_peak - CRP_log_1) |>
  select(SampleID, crp_difference)

cytokines_difference <- sos_cytokines_wide |>
  mutate(
    il10_difference = il10_peak - IL10_log_1,
    il6_difference = il6_peak - IL6_log_1,
    tnfa_difference = tnfa_peak - TNFalpha_log_1
  ) |>
  select(SampleID, il10_difference, il6_difference, tnfa_difference)

hormones_difference <- sos_hormones_wide |>
  mutate(
    dhea_difference = dhea_peak - DHEA_log_1,
    test_difference = test_peak - Testosterone_log_1,
    cort_difference = cort_peak - Cortisol_log_1
  ) |>
  select(SampleID, dhea_difference, test_difference, cort_difference)

biomarkers_difference <- crp_difference |>
  full_join(cytokines_difference, by = "SampleID") |>
  full_join(hormones_difference, by = "SampleID")

bio_all_difference <- hr_difference |>
  full_join(biomarkers_difference, by = "SampleID")

subj_stress_long <- sos_subj_stress |>
  pivot_longer(
    c(
      selfconnected_subj_stress,
      selfdisconnected_subj_stress,
      other_subj_stress
    ),
    names_to = "condition",
    values_to = "stress"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    condition = factor(
      condition,
      levels = c(
        "selfconnected_subj_stress",
        "selfdisconnected_subj_stress",
        "other_subj_stress"
      ),
      labels = c("Self-Connected", "Self-Disconnected", "Other")
    )
  )

summarize_se <- function(
  data,
  measure_var,
  group_vars = NULL,
  na.rm = FALSE,
  conf.interval = 0.95
) {
  data |>
    group_by(across(all_of(group_vars))) |>
    summarise(
      n = sum(!is.na(.data[[measure_var]])),
      !!measure_var := mean(.data[[measure_var]], na.rm = na.rm),
      sd = sd(.data[[measure_var]], na.rm = na.rm),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    mutate(se = sd / sqrt(n), ci = se * qt(conf.interval / 2 + 0.5, n - 1))
}

summary_subj <- summarize_se(
  subj_stress_long,
  measure_var = "stress",
  group_vars = "condition",
  na.rm = TRUE
)

wt_plt_sc_sd  <- wilcox.test(sos_subj_stress$selfconnected_subj_stress,
                              sos_subj_stress$selfdisconnected_subj_stress,
                              alternative = "greater", paired = TRUE)
wt_plt_sc_oth <- wilcox.test(sos_subj_stress$selfconnected_subj_stress,
                              sos_subj_stress$other_subj_stress,
                              alternative = "greater", paired = TRUE)
wt_plt_sd_oth <- wilcox.test(sos_subj_stress$selfdisconnected_subj_stress,
                              sos_subj_stress$other_subj_stress,
                              alternative = "greater", paired = TRUE)

subj_comparisons <- list(
  c("Self-Connected", "Self-Disconnected"),
  c("Self-Connected", "Other"),
  c("Self-Disconnected", "Other")
)

subj_plot <- ggplot(
  summary_subj,
  aes(x = condition, y = stress, fill = condition)
) +
  geom_bar(position = position_dodge(), stat = "identity") +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = stress - se, ymax = stress + se),
    width = 0.2,
    position = position_dodge(0.9)
  ) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d() +
  stat_summary(
    fun.data = make_box_stats(subj_stress_long, "stress"),
    geom = "text",
    hjust = 0.5,
    vjust = 0,
    size = 4,
    na.rm = TRUE,
    textsize = 3
  ) +
  geom_signif(
    comparisons = subj_comparisons,
    annotations = c(
      fmt_p_plain(wt_plt_sc_sd$p.value),
      fmt_p_plain(wt_plt_sc_oth$p.value),
      fmt_p_plain(wt_plt_sd_oth$p.value)
    ),
    tip_length = 0.02, vjust = -0.4, textsize = 4, y_position = c(3.5, 4.5, 4)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.45))) +
  ylab("Mean stress rating") +
  xlab("Condition") +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  theme_minimal()

subjective_difference <- sos_subj_stress |>
  mutate(
    subj_scsd_difference = selfconnected_subj_stress -
      selfdisconnected_subj_stress,
    subj_scother_difference = selfconnected_subj_stress - other_subj_stress
  ) |>
  select(SampleID, subj_scsd_difference, subj_scother_difference)

all_difference <- bio_all_difference |>
  full_join(subjective_difference, by = "SampleID")

# Peak t-tests and FDR correction (immune and hormones corrected separately)
peak_tests_raw <- list(
  crp = run_peak_test("crp_peak", "CRP_log_1", sos_crp_wide),
  il10 = run_peak_test("il10_peak", "IL10_log_1", sos_cytokines_wide),
  il6 = run_peak_test("il6_peak", "IL6_log_1", sos_cytokines_wide),
  tnfa = run_peak_test("tnfa_peak", "TNFalpha_log_1", sos_cytokines_wide),
  dhea = run_peak_test("dhea_peak", "DHEA_log_1", sos_hormones_wide),
  test = run_peak_test("test_peak", "Testosterone_log_1", sos_hormones_wide),
  cort = run_peak_test("cort_peak", "Cortisol_log_1", sos_hormones_wide)
)
peak_praw <- map_dbl(peak_tests_raw, \(t) t$p.value)
peak_pfdr <- setNames(
  c(
    p.adjust(peak_praw[1:4], method = "fdr"),
    p.adjust(peak_praw[5:7], method = "fdr")
  ),
  names(peak_praw)
)
```

# Sample Descriptives

## Age

```{r age-descriptives}
# Age at session (also reused as age_df in the Hypothesis 2 puberty-load chunk)
dob_session_raw <- read.csv(file.path(
  data_path, "SOS/SOS-study-monash/questionnaires/SOS_DOB_sessiondate.csv"
)) |>
  mutate(SampleID = sub("_", "", subject_spit_id))

age_df <- dob_session_raw |>
  filter(redcap_event_name == "ongoing_records_arm_1") |>
  select(SampleID, dob) |>
  mutate(dob = as.Date(dob)) |>
  inner_join(
    dob_session_raw |>
      filter(redcap_event_name == "sos_arm_1") |>
      select(SampleID, sos_session_date) |>
      mutate(sos_session_date = as.Date(sos_session_date)),
    by = "SampleID"
  ) |>
  mutate(age_at_session = as.numeric(sos_session_date - dob) / 365.25) |>
  select(SampleID, age_at_session) |>
  # Scoped to the actual SOS biomarker analytic sample (N=78; CRP, cytokines,
  # and hormones panels share the exact same 78 SampleIDs). Without this,
  # age_df pulls anyone merely logged/scheduled for an SOS visit in REDCap
  # (ongoing_records_arm_1 x sos_arm_1), which includes 13 people with no
  # biomarker or questionnaire data at all (likely no-shows/incomplete
  # sessions) and inflates n to 88. This join is not a duplicate-row bug —
  # both REDCap event filters were checked and have zero duplicate
  # SampleIDs — it's a sample-scope mismatch.
  # Note: this scoping still only recovers 76 of the 78 analytic-sample
  # participants (75 with a valid computed age). TAG122 and TAG305 are in
  # the biomarker analytic sample but have no matching DOB/session-date
  # record in SOS_DOB_sessiondate.csv, and TAG313 matches but has a
  # malformed/missing date field that computes to NA age. 
  semi_join(
    bind_rows(sos_crp_panel, sos_cytokines_panel, sos_hormones_panel),
    by = "SampleID"
  )

age_df |>
  summarise(
    n    = sum(!is.na(age_at_session)),
    Mean = round(mean(age_at_session, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    SD   = round(sd(age_at_session,   na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    Min  = round(min(age_at_session,  na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    Max  = round(max(age_at_session,  na.rm = TRUE), 2)
  ) |>
  kable(caption = "Age at session (years)") |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "hover", full_width = FALSE)
```

```{r age-distribution}
age_df |>
  filter(!is.na(age_at_session)) |>
  mutate(age_bin = cut(age_at_session,
                        breaks = seq(floor(min(age_at_session)), ceiling(max(age_at_session)), by = 1),
                        right = FALSE)) |>
  count(age_bin, name = "n") |>
  mutate(pct = round(100 * n / sum(n), 1)) |>
  kable(col.names = c("Age (years)", "n", "%"),
        caption = "Distribution of age at session") |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "hover", full_width = FALSE)
```

# Peak Timepoint Distribution

Before the immune and hormone reactivity models (Hypothesis 1a), we characterized *when*
each person's peak biomarker value occurred across all four saliva collection timepoints
(T1–T4), rather than restricting "peak" to T3 vs. T4 as in the reactivity analyses below.
For each biomarker, each participant is assigned the timepoint at which their
(log-transformed) concentration was highest, using whichever timepoints they have
non-missing data for. Ties (identical values at two timepoints) are broken in favor of
the earlier timepoint.

```{r peak-timepoint-processing, echo=FALSE}
peak_timepoint_counts <- function(wide_data, cols, biomarker_name) {
  wide_data |>
    select(SampleID, all_of(cols)) |>
    pivot_longer(-SampleID, names_to = "time_point", values_to = "value") |>
    filter(!is.na(value)) |>
    group_by(SampleID) |>
    slice_max(value, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>
    ungroup() |>
    mutate(
      time_point = paste0("T", str_extract(time_point, "\\d$")),
      time_point = factor(time_point, levels = paste0("T", 1:4))
    ) |>
    count(time_point, .drop = FALSE, name = "n") |>
    mutate(biomarker = biomarker_name, pct = round(100 * n / sum(n), 1))
}

peak_timepoint_tbl <- bind_rows(
  peak_timepoint_counts(sos_crp_wide,       paste0("CRP_log_",          1:4), "CRP"),
  peak_timepoint_counts(sos_cytokines_wide, paste0("IL10_log_",         1:4), "IL-10"),
  peak_timepoint_counts(sos_cytokines_wide, paste0("IL6_log_",          1:4), "IL-6"),
  peak_timepoint_counts(sos_cytokines_wide, paste0("TNFalpha_log_",     1:4), "TNF-alpha"),
  peak_timepoint_counts(sos_hormones_wide,  paste0("DHEA_log_",         1:4), "DHEA"),
  peak_timepoint_counts(sos_hormones_wide,  paste0("Testosterone_log_", 1:4), "Testosterone"),
  peak_timepoint_counts(sos_hormones_wide,  paste0("Cortisol_log_",     1:4), "Cortisol")
) |>
  mutate(biomarker = factor(biomarker,
    levels = c("CRP", "IL-10", "IL-6", "TNF-alpha", "DHEA", "Testosterone", "Cortisol")))
```

  arrange(biomarker) |>

# Hypothesis 1a: Biomarker Time Trends

*Hypothesis 1a (manuscript): "We estimated both the linear and quadratic effects of time point on each immune and hormone biomarker using a random intercept and a random effect of time point nested within participants."*

## Model Comparison (AIC / BIC)

```{r model-comparison}
mlm_list <- list(
  CRP = mlm_crp, `IL-10` = mlm_il10, `IL-6` = mlm_il6, `TNF-alpha` = mlm_tnfalpha,
  DHEA = mlm_dhea, Testosterone = mlm_test, Cortisol = mlm_cort
)

model_comp_tbl <- imap_dfr(mlm_list, function(res, name) {
  tibble(
    biomarker = name,
    Model   = c("Linear", "Quadratic"),
    df      = res$aic$df,
    AIC     = round(res$aic$AIC, 1),
    BIC     = round(res$bic$BIC, 1)
  )
})

best_rows <- model_comp_tbl |>
  group_by(biomarker) |>
  mutate(is_best = AIC == min(AIC)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  pull(is_best)

model_comp_tbl |>
  kable() |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "hover", full_width = FALSE) |>
  row_spec(which(best_rows), bold = TRUE, color = "#2166ac")
```

A significant LRT indicates that adding the quadratic time term significantly improves model fit.

```{r model-lrt}
lrt_tbl <- imap_dfr(mlm_list, function(res, name) {
  a       <- anova(res$linear, res$quadratic, refit = TRUE)
  p_col   <- grep("Pr", colnames(a), value = TRUE)[1]
  tibble(
    biomarker = name,
    chisq   = round(a$Chisq[2], 2),
    p_raw   = as.numeric(a[2, p_col])
  )
}) |>
  mutate(
    group = c(rep("Immune", 4), rep("Hormones", 3)),
    p_fdr = c(
      p.adjust(p_raw[1:4], method = "fdr"),
      p.adjust(p_raw[5:7], method = "fdr")
    )
  )

lrt_tbl |>
  mutate(
    p_raw_disp = round(p_raw, 4),
    p_fdr_disp = cell_spec(round(p_fdr, 4), bold = p_fdr < 0.05,
      color = if_else(p_fdr < 0.05, "#2166ac", "black"))
  ) |>
  select(biomarker, group, chisq, p_raw_disp, p_fdr_disp) |>
  kable(escape = FALSE,
        col.names = c("biomarker", "Group", "chi-sq", "p (raw)", "p (FDR)"),
        caption = "Likelihood ratio test: quadratic vs. linear (FDR-corrected within immune and hormone groups; bold = p_FDR < .05)") |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "hover", full_width = FALSE)
```

```{r biomarker-trends-results-vals, echo=FALSE, include=FALSE}
best_model_tbl <- model_comp_tbl |>
  group_by(biomarker) |>
  slice_min(AIC, n = 1) |>
  ungroup()
n_quad <- sum(best_model_tbl$Model == "Quadratic")
n_lin  <- sum(best_model_tbl$Model == "Linear")
quad_biomarkers <- best_model_tbl |> filter(Model == "Quadratic") |> pull(biomarker) |> paste(collapse = ", ")
lin_biomarkers  <- best_model_tbl |> filter(Model == "Linear")    |> pull(biomarker) |> paste(collapse = ", ")

n_lrt_sig     <- sum(lrt_tbl$p_fdr < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)
lrt_sig_names <- lrt_tbl |> filter(p_fdr < 0.05) |> pull(biomarker) |> paste(collapse = ", ")
lrt_ns_names  <- lrt_tbl |> filter(p_fdr >= 0.05) |> pull(biomarker) |> paste(collapse = ", ")
```

**Results.** We modeled log-transformed biomarker concentrations across four timepoints (T1–T4) using linear mixed models. A quadratic time term provided the lowest AIC for `r n_quad` of 7 biomarkers (`r quad_biomarkers`)`r if (n_lin > 0) paste0(", with a linear trajectory preferred for ", lin_biomarkers)`. Likelihood ratio tests (quadratic vs. linear) were FDR-corrected within immune markers and hormones separately; the quadratic term significantly improved fit for `r n_lrt_sig` biomarker`r if (n_lrt_sig != 1) "s"``r if (n_lrt_sig > 0) paste0(" (", lrt_sig_names, ")")``r if (nchar(lrt_ns_names) > 0) paste0("; the improvement was not significant for ", lrt_ns_names)`. Fixed effects are shown below with FDR-corrected p-values within each term across immune markers and hormones separately.

## Fixed Effects: Quadratic Models {.tabset}

```{r quad-fixed-effects, results='asis'}
# Collect all fixed effects, then FDR-correct within term × group
all_fixed_effects <- imap_dfr(mlm_list, function(res, name) {
  broom.mixed::tidy(res$quadratic, effects = "fixed") |>
    mutate(biomarker = name)
}) |>
  mutate(group = if_else(
    biomarker %in% c("CRP", "IL-10", "IL-6", "TNF-alpha"), "Immune", "Hormones"
  )) |>
  group_by(term, group) |>
  mutate(p_fdr = p.adjust(p.value, method = "fdr")) |>
  ungroup()

iwalk(mlm_list, function(res, name) {
  cat("\n\n### ", name, "\n\n")
  tbl <- all_fixed_effects |>
    filter(biomarker == name) |>
    select(term, estimate, std.error, statistic, df, p.value, p_fdr) |>
    mutate(
      across(c(estimate, std.error, statistic, df), \(x) round(x, 3)),
      p.value = round(p.value, 4),
      p_fdr   = round(p_fdr,   4)
    )
  tbl |>
    mutate(p_fdr = cell_spec(p_fdr, bold = !is.na(p_fdr) & p_fdr < 0.05,
      color = if_else(!is.na(p_fdr) & p_fdr < 0.05, "#2166ac", "black"))) |>
    kable(escape = FALSE,
          col.names = c("Term", "b", "SE", "t", "df", "p (raw)", "p (FDR)")) |>
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "hover", full_width = FALSE) |>
    print()
})
```

## Individual Growth Curves

Each person's observed trajectory (thin grey lines) with individual model-fitted curves
(thin coloured lines, based on random slope/intercept estimates) and the population-average
quadratic trajectory (thick line).

```{r ind-growth-curves, fig.width=12, fig.height=8}
panel_map <- list(
  "CRP"          = list(data = sos_crp_panel,       col = "CRP_log"),
  "IL-10"        = list(data = sos_cytokines_panel, col = "IL10_log"),
  "IL-6"         = list(data = sos_cytokines_panel, col = "IL6_log"),
  "TNF-alpha"    = list(data = sos_cytokines_panel, col = "TNFalpha_log"),
  "DHEA"         = list(data = sos_hormones_panel,  col = "DHEA_log"),
  "Testosterone" = list(data = sos_hormones_panel,  col = "Testosterone_log"),
  "Cortisol"     = list(data = sos_hormones_panel,  col = "Cortisol_log")
)

ind_curve_data <- imap_dfr(mlm_list, function(res, name) {
  pm      <- panel_map[[name]]
  obs_dat <- pm$data |>
    select(SampleID, Time, value = all_of(pm$col)) |>
    filter(!is.na(value))

  obs_dat |>
    mutate(
      fitted_ind = predict(res$quadratic, newdata = obs_dat),
      fitted_pop = predict(res$quadratic, newdata = obs_dat, re.form = NA),
      biomarker    = name
    )
}) |>
  mutate(
    biomarker = recode(biomarker, "TNF-alpha" = "TNF-α"),
    biomarker = factor(biomarker,
      levels = c("CRP", "IL-10", "IL-6", "TNF-α", "DHEA", "Testosterone", "Cortisol"))
  )

pop_curve <- ind_curve_data |>
  group_by(biomarker, Time) |>
  summarise(fitted_pop = mean(fitted_pop, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

ggplot(ind_curve_data, aes(x = Time, group = SampleID)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = value),      color = "gray70", linewidth = 0.35, alpha = 0.6) +

            linewidth = 0.5, alpha = 0.45, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_line(data = pop_curve,
            aes(x = Time, y = fitted_pop, group = NULL),
            color = "black", linewidth = 1.3, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:4, labels = paste0("T", 1:4)) +
  scale_color_viridis_d() +
  facet_wrap(~biomarker, scales = "free_y", ncol = 4) +
  labs(x = "Timepoint", y = "Concentration (log-transformed)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"))
```

# Hypothesis 1a (continued): Biomarker Reactivity (Peak vs. Baseline)

*Hypothesis 1a (manuscript): peak (T3 or T4, whichever higher) compared to T1 via one-tailed paired t-tests, FDR-corrected separately within immune markers (4 tests) and hormones (3 tests); reactivity = peak − T1.*

Each person's peak is the higher of T3 or T4. Reactivity score = peak − T1 (positive = increase from baseline).

## Peak vs. T1 t-tests

```{r peak-ttests}
peak_ttest_tbl <- peak_tests_raw |>
  map(broom::tidy) |>
  list_rbind(names_to = "biomarker") |>
  mutate(biomarker = case_match(
    biomarker,
    "crp" ~ "CRP", "il10" ~ "IL-10", "il6" ~ "IL-6", "tnfa" ~ "TNF-alpha",
    "dhea" ~ "DHEA", "test" ~ "Testosterone", "cort" ~ "Cortisol"
  )) |>
  select(biomarker, estimate, statistic, parameter, p.value) |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 3)))

peak_ttest_tbl |>
  mutate(p.value = cell_spec(p.value, bold = p.value < 0.05,
    color = if_else(p.value < 0.05, "#2166ac", "black"))) |>
  kable(col.names = c("biomarker", "Mean diff (peak − T1)", "t", "df", "p (one-tailed)"), escape = FALSE) |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "hover", full_width = FALSE)
```

## FDR Correction

```{r fdr}
fdr_tbl <- tibble(
  group   = c(rep("Immune", 4), rep("Hormones", 3)),
  biomarker = c("CRP", "IL-10", "IL-6", "TNF-alpha", "DHEA", "Testosterone", "Cortisol"),
  p_raw   = round(peak_praw, 6),
  p_fdr   = peak_pfdr
)

fdr_tbl |>
  mutate(p_fdr = cell_spec(round(p_fdr, 4), bold = p_fdr < 0.05,
    color = if_else(p_fdr < 0.05, "#2166ac", "black"))) |>
  kable(col.names = c("Group", "biomarker", "p (raw)", "p (FDR)"), escape = FALSE) |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "hover", full_width = FALSE)
```

```{r reactivity-results-vals, echo=FALSE, include=FALSE}
sig_immune  <- fdr_tbl |> filter(group == "Immune",   p_fdr < 0.05) |> pull(biomarker)
sig_hormone <- fdr_tbl |> filter(group == "Hormones", p_fdr < 0.05) |> pull(biomarker)
ns_immune   <- fdr_tbl |> filter(group == "Immune",   p_fdr >= 0.05) |> pull(biomarker)
ns_hormone  <- fdr_tbl |> filter(group == "Hormones", p_fdr >= 0.05) |> pull(biomarker)

fmt_sig <- function(x) if (length(x) == 0) "none" else paste(x, collapse = ", ")

react_means <- biomarkers_difference |>
  summarise(across(-SampleID, \(x) round(mean(x, na.rm = TRUE), 3)))
react_sds <- biomarkers_difference |>
  summarise(across(-SampleID, \(x) round(sd(x, na.rm = TRUE), 3)))

peak_tbl_lookup <- peak_ttest_tbl
get_peak <- function(biomarker_name, col) {
  peak_tbl_lookup[peak_tbl_lookup$biomarker == biomarker_name, col]
}
```

**Results.** Biomarker reactivity was operationalized as the difference between each participant's peak sample (T3 or T4) and baseline (T1). After FDR correction within immune markers and hormones separately, significant baseline-to-peak increases were observed for the following immune markers: `r fmt_sig(sig_immune)`; and for the following hormones: `r fmt_sig(sig_hormone)`. `r if (length(ns_immune) > 0) paste0(paste(ns_immune, collapse=", "), " did not show significant immune reactivity after FDR correction.")` `r if (length(ns_hormone) > 0) paste0(paste(ns_hormone, collapse=", "), " did not show significant hormonal reactivity after FDR correction.")`

## T3 vs. T4: Which Timepoint Captured the Peak?

*Restricting attention to T3 and T4 only (T2 is excluded here — it may reflect scan-environment
arousal or TiM task recording rather than the SOS task itself): for each biomarker, how many participants' peak
(the higher of T3/T4) fell at T3 vs. T4 — both overall, and restricted to participants who
showed an actual increase over T1 ("responders").*

```{r t3-vs-t4-counts, echo=FALSE}
count_t3_vs_t4 <- function(data, t3_col, t4_col, t1_col) {
  dat <- data |> select(all_of(c(t3_col, t4_col, t1_col))) |> na.omit()
  peak <- pmax(dat[[t3_col]], dat[[t4_col]])
  resp <- peak > dat[[t1_col]]
  tibble(
    n_valid          = nrow(dat),
    n_peaked_T3      = sum(dat[[t3_col]] > dat[[t4_col]]),
    n_peaked_T4      = sum(dat[[t4_col]] > dat[[t3_col]]),
    n_tie            = sum(dat[[t3_col]] == dat[[t4_col]]),
    n_responders     = sum(resp),
    n_resp_peaked_T3 = sum(dat[[t3_col]] > dat[[t4_col]] & resp),
    n_resp_peaked_T4 = sum(dat[[t4_col]] > dat[[t3_col]] & resp)
  )
}

t3_vs_t4_specs <- list(
  CRP          = list(d = sos_crp_wide,       t3 = "CRP_log_3",          t4 = "CRP_log_4",          t1 = "CRP_log_1"),
  `IL-10`      = list(d = sos_cytokines_wide, t3 = "IL10_log_3",         t4 = "IL10_log_4",         t1 = "IL10_log_1"),
  `IL-6`       = list(d = sos_cytokines_wide, t3 = "IL6_log_3",          t4 = "IL6_log_4",          t1 = "IL6_log_1"),
  `TNF-alpha`  = list(d = sos_cytokines_wide, t3 = "TNFalpha_log_3",     t4 = "TNFalpha_log_4",     t1 = "TNFalpha_log_1"),
  DHEA         = list(d = sos_hormones_wide,  t3 = "DHEA_log_3",         t4 = "DHEA_log_4",         t1 = "DHEA_log_1"),
  Testosterone = list(d = sos_hormones_wide,  t3 = "Testosterone_log_3", t4 = "Testosterone_log_4", t1 = "Testosterone_log_1"),
  Cortisol     = list(d = sos_hormones_wide,  t3 = "Cortisol_log_3",     t4 = "Cortisol_log_4",     t1 = "Cortisol_log_1")
)

t3_vs_t4_tbl <- imap_dfr(t3_vs_t4_specs, function(s, name) {
  count_t3_vs_t4(s$d, s$t3, s$t4, s$t1) |> mutate(biomarker = name, .before = 1)
})
```

```{r t3-vs-t4-table-all}
t3_vs_t4_tbl |>
  select(biomarker, n_valid, n_peaked_T3, n_peaked_T4, n_tie) |>
  kable(col.names = c("biomarker", "N (valid T3 & T4)", "Peaked at T3", "Peaked at T4", "Tied"),
        caption = "Which timepoint (T3 or T4) had the higher value, all participants") |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "hover", full_width = FALSE)
```

```{r t3-vs-t4-table-responders}
t3_vs_t4_tbl |>
  select(biomarker, n_responders, n_resp_peaked_T3, n_resp_peaked_T4) |>
  kable(col.names = c("biomarker", "N responders (peak > T1)", "...peaked at T3", "...peaked at T4"),
        caption = "Among responders only: which timepoint (T3 or T4) captured the peak") |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "hover", full_width = FALSE)
```

```{r t3-vs-t4-results-vals, echo=FALSE, include=FALSE}
t3_lean_df <- t3_vs_t4_tbl |> filter(n_resp_peaked_T3 > n_resp_peaked_T4)
t4_lean_df <- t3_vs_t4_tbl |> filter(n_resp_peaked_T4 > n_resp_peaked_T3)
t3_lean <- if (nrow(t3_lean_df) == 0) "none" else paste(t3_lean_df$biomarker, collapse = ", ")
t4_lean <- if (nrow(t4_lean_df) == 0) "none" else paste(t4_lean_df$biomarker, collapse = ", ")
```

**Results.** Among responders (participants whose peak — the higher of T3 or T4 — exceeded
their own T1 baseline), the following biomarkers leaned toward peaking at T3 rather than T4:
`r t3_lean`. The following leaned toward peaking at T4 rather than T3: `r t4_lean`.

# Hypothesis 1b: Heart Rate Reactivity

*Hypothesis 1b (manuscript): task heart rate vs. resting-state baseline (two 5-min pre-task scans), and Self-Connected vs. Self-Disconnected/Other/fixation-cross, via one-tailed paired t-tests.*

## Descriptive Means

```{r hr-descriptives}
tibble(
  Condition = c(
    "Resting 1", "Resting 2", "Resting Average", "Task (overall)",
    "Within-task: Fixation-Cross", "Within-task: Other",
    "Within-task: Self-Disconnected", "Within-task: Self-Connected"
  ),
  `Mean HR (bpm)` = round(c(
    mean(hr_all_wide$`Resting 1`),
    mean(hr_all_wide$`Resting 2`, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean(hr_all_wide$resting_avg),
    mean(hr_all_wide$Task),
    mean(pull_hr("Fixation-Cross")),
    mean(pull_hr("Other")),
    mean(pull_hr("Self-Disconnected")),
    mean(pull_hr("Self-Connected"))
  ), 2)
) |>
  kable()
```

## HR Difference Score Descriptives

```{r hr-diff-descriptives}
bind_rows(
  hr_difference |> select(-SampleID) |> summarise(across(everything(), \(x) mean(x, na.rm = TRUE))) |> mutate(stat = "Mean"),
  hr_difference |> select(-SampleID) |> summarise(across(everything(), \(x) sd(x,   na.rm = TRUE))) |> mutate(stat = "SD")
) |>
  select(stat, everything()) |>
  rename(
    `ΔHR: Task vs. Rest`  = task_rs_hr_diff,
    `ΔHR: SC vs. SD`      = conn_dis_hr_diff,
    `ΔHR: SC vs. Other`   = conn_other_hr_diff,
    `ΔHR: SC vs. Fixation-Cross` = conn_rest_hr_diff
  ) |>
  kable(digits = 3, caption = "HR reactivity difference scores (positive = higher during more self-connected/active condition)")
```

## Paired t-tests

```{r hr-ttests}
hr_ttest_tbl <- list(
  "Task vs. Resting" = t.test(hr_all_wide$Task, hr_all_wide$resting_avg, alternative = "greater", paired = TRUE),
  "Self-Connected vs. Fixation-Cross" = t.test(pull_hr("Self-Connected"), pull_hr("Fixation-Cross"), alternative = "greater", paired = TRUE),
  "Self-Connected vs. Self-Disconnected" = t.test(pull_hr("Self-Connected"), pull_hr("Self-Disconnected"), alternative = "greater", paired = TRUE),
  "Self-Connected vs. Other" = t.test(pull_hr("Self-Connected"), pull_hr("Other"), alternative = "greater", paired = TRUE)
) |>
  map(broom::tidy) |>
  list_rbind(names_to = "comparison") |>
  select(comparison, estimate, statistic, parameter, p.value) |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 3)))

hr_ttest_tbl |>
  mutate(p.value = cell_spec(p.value, bold = p.value < 0.05,
    color = if_else(p.value < 0.05, "#2166ac", "black"))) |>
  kable(col.names = c("Comparison", "Mean diff", "t", "df", "p"), escape = FALSE) |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "hover", full_width = FALSE)
```

```{r hr-results-vals, echo=FALSE, include=FALSE}
hr_task_rest <- hr_ttest_tbl |> filter(comparison == "Task vs. Resting")
hr_sc_sd     <- hr_ttest_tbl |> filter(comparison == "Self-Connected vs. Self-Disconnected")
hr_sc_oth    <- hr_ttest_tbl |> filter(comparison == "Self-Connected vs. Other")
hr_sc_rest   <- hr_ttest_tbl |> filter(comparison == "Self-Connected vs. Fixation-Cross")
fmt_p_txt    <- function(p) ifelse(p < .001, "< .001", paste0("= ", round(p, 3)))
```

**Results.** Heart rate was significantly higher during the SOS task compared to the pre-task resting scan (*M*~diff~ = `r hr_task_rest$estimate` bpm, *t*(`r hr_task_rest$parameter`) = `r hr_task_rest$statistic`, *p* `r fmt_p_txt(hr_task_rest$p.value)`). Within the task, heart rate during the Self-Connected condition was significantly higher than both the Self-Disconnected condition (*M*~diff~ = `r hr_sc_sd$estimate` bpm, *t*(`r hr_sc_sd$parameter`) = `r hr_sc_sd$statistic`, *p* `r fmt_p_txt(hr_sc_sd$p.value)`) and the Other condition (*M*~diff~ = `r hr_sc_oth$estimate` bpm, *t*(`r hr_sc_oth$parameter`) = `r hr_sc_oth$statistic`, *p* `r fmt_p_txt(hr_sc_oth$p.value)`), and compared to the within-task fixation-cross period (*M*~diff~ = `r hr_sc_rest$estimate` bpm, *t*(`r hr_sc_rest$parameter`) = `r hr_sc_rest$statistic`, *p* `r fmt_p_txt(hr_sc_rest$p.value)`).

# Hypothesis 1c: Subjective Stress Reactivity

*Hypothesis 1c (manuscript): Self-Connected Likert stress ratings vs. Self-Disconnected and Other, via Wilcoxon signed-rank tests (ordinal ratings).*

## Descriptives

```{r subj-stress-descriptives}
bind_rows(
  subjective_difference |> select(-SampleID) |> summarise(across(everything(), \(x) mean(x, na.rm = TRUE))) |> mutate(stat = "Mean"),
  subjective_difference |> select(-SampleID) |> summarise(across(everything(), \(x) sd(x,   na.rm = TRUE))) |> mutate(stat = "SD")
) |>
  select(stat, everything()) |>
  rename(
    `ΔSubjective Stress: SC vs. SD`    = subj_scsd_difference,
    `ΔSubjective Stress: SC vs. Other` = subj_scother_difference
  ) |>
  kable(digits = 3, caption = "Subjective stress difference scores (positive = higher stress during Self-Connected)")
```

## Plot

```{r subj-stress-plot, fig.width=6, fig.height=6}
subj_plot
```

```{r subj-results-vals, echo=FALSE, include=FALSE}
# Run Wilcoxon tests explicitly so values are available for inline text
subj_wide <- sos_subj_stress
wt_sc_sd  <- wilcox.test(subj_wide$selfconnected_subj_stress,
                          subj_wide$selfdisconnected_subj_stress,
                          paired = TRUE, alternative = "greater")
wt_sc_oth <- wilcox.test(subj_wide$selfconnected_subj_stress,
                          subj_wide$other_subj_stress,
                          paired = TRUE, alternative = "greater")
m_sc  <- round(mean(subj_wide$selfconnected_subj_stress,  na.rm = TRUE), 2)
m_sd2 <- round(mean(subj_wide$selfdisconnected_subj_stress, na.rm = TRUE), 2)
m_oth <- round(mean(subj_wide$other_subj_stress,           na.rm = TRUE), 2)
sd_sc  <- round(sd(subj_wide$selfconnected_subj_stress,    na.rm = TRUE), 2)
sd_sd2 <- round(sd(subj_wide$selfdisconnected_subj_stress, na.rm = TRUE), 2)
sd_oth <- round(sd(subj_wide$other_subj_stress,            na.rm = TRUE), 2)
```

**Results.** Participants reported the highest subjective stress during the Self-Connected condition (*M* = `r m_sc`, *SD* = `r sd_sc`), relative to both the Self-Disconnected condition (*M* = `r m_sd2`, *SD* = `r sd_sd2`; Wilcoxon *W* = `r wt_sc_sd$statistic`, *p* `r fmt_p_txt(wt_sc_sd$p.value)`) and the Other condition (*M* = `r m_oth`, *SD* = `r sd_oth`; Wilcoxon *W* = `r wt_sc_oth$statistic`, *p* `r fmt_p_txt(wt_sc_oth$p.value)`).

# Hypothesis 1d: Correlations Among Reactivity Measures

*Hypothesis 1d (manuscript): bivariate Pearson correlations among all magnitude-of-change (reactivity) difference scores.*

```{r corr-matrix, fig.width=10, fig.height=9}
diff_matrix <- all_difference |> select(-SampleID) |> as.matrix()
colnames(diff_matrix) <- c(
  "ΔHR: Task vs. Rest", "ΔHR: SC vs. SD", "ΔHR: SC vs. Other", "ΔHR: SC vs. Fixation-Cross",
  "ΔCRP", "ΔIL-10", "ΔIL-6", "ΔTNF-α", "ΔDHEA", "ΔTestosterone", "ΔCortisol",
  "ΔSubj Stress: SC vs. SD", "ΔSubj Stress: SC vs. Other"
)
difference_rcorrs <- rcorr(diff_matrix)

plot_sig_corrplot <- function(r_mat, p_mat, title = "", type = "upper",
                              cl.ratio = 0.15, cl.cex = 1.15,
                              tl.cex = 1.0, mar = NULL, diag = FALSE) {
  if (is.null(mar)) {
    mar <- c(0, 0, if (nchar(title) > 0) 2 else 0, 0)
  }
  corrplot(
    r_mat,
    p.mat     = p_mat,
    sig.level = 0.05,
    insig     = "pch",
    pch       = 4,
    pch.col   = "black",
    pch.cex   = 2.5,
    method    = "circle",
    type      = type,
    tl.col    = "black",
    tl.srt    = 45,
    tl.cex    = tl.cex,
    col       = colorRampPalette(c("#d73027", "white", "#4575b4"))(200),
    diag      = diag,
    title     = title,
    mar       = mar,
    cl.ratio  = cl.ratio,
    cl.cex    = cl.cex
  )
}

diff_domains <- list(
  hr      = 1:4,
  immune  = 5:8,
  hormone = 9:11,
  subj    = 12:13
)

fdr_diff_mat <- difference_rcorrs$P
for (idx in diff_domains) {
  sub <- fdr_diff_mat[idx, idx, drop = FALSE]
  ut  <- upper.tri(sub)
  sub[ut] <- p.adjust(sub[ut], method = "fdr")
  sub[lower.tri(sub)] <- t(sub)[lower.tri(sub)]
  fdr_diff_mat[idx, idx] <- sub
}

plot_sig_corrplot(difference_rcorrs$r, fdr_diff_mat)
```

*Circle size and color reflect correlation magnitude (red = negative, blue = positive). X marks indicate non-significant correlations after FDR correction (p~FDR~ ≥ .05). FDR applied within domain (HR, immune markers, hormones, subjective stress); cross-domain pairs shown at raw p.*

## Correlation p-values

```{r corr-pvalues}
# fdr_diff_mat already computed in corr-matrix chunk above
fdr_diff_mat |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  mutate(across(everything(), \(x) {
    sig  <- !is.na(x) & x < 0.05
    xlab <- if_else(is.na(x), "—", as.character(round(x, 4)))
    cell_spec(xlab, bold = sig, color = if_else(sig, "#2166ac", "black"))
  })) |>
  kable(escape = FALSE,
        caption = "P-values FDR-corrected within domain (HR, immune, hormones, subjective stress); cross-domain pairs raw (bold = p < .05).") |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "hover")
```

```{r corr-results-vals, echo=FALSE, include=FALSE}
p_upper <- fdr_diff_mat
p_upper[lower.tri(p_upper, diag = TRUE)] <- NA
r_upper <- difference_rcorrs$r
r_upper[lower.tri(r_upper, diag = TRUE)] <- NA

n_corr_pairs_total <- sum(!is.na(p_upper))
n_corr_sig         <- sum(p_upper < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)

# Largest positive and negative r among sig pairs
sig_r_vals <- r_upper[!is.na(p_upper) & p_upper < 0.05]
corr_r_range <- if (length(sig_r_vals) > 0) {
  paste0("ranging from r = ", round(min(sig_r_vals), 2), " to r = ", round(max(sig_r_vals), 2))
} else {
  ""
}
```

**Results.** Bivariate Pearson correlations among the 13 reactivity difference scores are shown in the matrix above (full p-value table below). P-values were FDR-corrected within domain (among the four HR reactivity measures, among immune markers, among hormones, and among subjective stress ratings); cross-domain pairs are reported at raw p. Of `r n_corr_pairs_total` unique pairs, `r n_corr_sig` were statistically significant (`r corr_r_range`). Within-domain associations tended to be positive, reflecting coherence within each response system. Cross-domain associations between physiological and subjective reactivity are reported in context throughout the sections below.

# Hypothesis 2: Puberty and Reactivity

*Hypothesis 2 (manuscript): bivariate Pearson correlations between each of the 13 reactivity outcomes and pubertal status (PDS score average), and three operationalizations of pubertal timing: (1) status-for-age (effect of pubertal status while controlling for age), (2) perceived pubertal timing reported from the PDS and (3) age at menarche.*

Note: pubertal status is tested here using the PUBcomp composite (PDS+line drawings composite), computed in `pubcomp-SOS.R` from `data/SOS-pubcomp.csv`. Age at menarche and self-reported perceived timing (PDS F5) still come from the raw PDS questionnaire, since those items are not carried forward into `SOS-pubcomp.csv`. Both puberty and age are centered in the first timing operationalization.

```{r puberty-load, echo=FALSE}
# dob_session_raw and age_df (age at session, for computing pubertal timing
# residuals) were already loaded in the Sample Descriptives > Age chunk above.

# Pubertal status: PUBcomp (PDS+line drawings composite), computed in pubcomp-SOS.R
# from data/SOS-pubcomp.csv
sos_puberty <- read.csv(here::here("data", "SOS-pubcomp.csv")) |>
  select(SampleID = SID, PUBcomp)

# PDS F5 (perceived timing) and menarche date are not carried forward into
# SOS-pubcomp.csv, so they're still read from the raw PDS questionnaire
pds_full_raw <- read.csv(file.path(
  data_path, "SOS/SOS-study-monash/questionnaires/CESD_PDS.csv"
))

pds_f5_df <- pds_full_raw |>
  select(SampleID, PDS_F5) |>
  mutate(PDS_F5 = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(PDS_F5)))

timing_base <- sos_puberty |>
  left_join(age_df, by = "SampleID") |>
  filter(!is.na(age_at_session))

# Age at menarche: parse PDS_F9 (free-text date of first period) + DOB → age in years
pds_raw <- pds_full_raw |>
  select(SampleID, menarche_date_raw = PDS_F9)

parse_menarche_date <- function(x) {
  x <- trimws(x)
  x <- gsub("(\\d+)(st|nd|rd|th)", "\\1", x, ignore.case = TRUE)  # strip ordinals
  suppressWarnings(lubridate::parse_date_time(
    x,
    orders = c("mdy", "mdY", "BdY", "bdY",
               "YBd", "Ybd", "BY", "bY", "by",   # "by" catches "Sep-17"
               "Y", "dBY", "dbY"),
    quiet  = TRUE
  ))
}

dob_df <- dob_session_raw |>
  filter(redcap_event_name == "ongoing_records_arm_1") |>
  select(SampleID, dob) |>
  mutate(dob = as.Date(dob))

menarche_df <- pds_raw |>
  left_join(dob_df, by = "SampleID") |>
  mutate(
    menarche_date = as.Date(parse_menarche_date(menarche_date_raw)),
    age_menarche  = as.numeric(menarche_date - dob) / 365.25
  ) |>
  select(SampleID, age_menarche)

timing_df <- timing_base |>
  left_join(menarche_df, by = "SampleID") |>
  left_join(pds_f5_df, by = "SampleID") |>
  mutate(
    PUBcomp_c         = PUBcomp         - mean(PUBcomp,         na.rm = TRUE),
    age_at_session_c  = age_at_session  - mean(age_at_session,  na.rm = TRUE),
    age_menarche_c    = age_menarche    - mean(age_menarche,    na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |>
  select(SampleID, age_at_session, age_at_session_c,
         PUBcomp, PUBcomp_c, age_menarche, age_menarche_c, PDS_F5)
```

```{r puberty-processing, echo=FALSE}
# Join puberty data with reactivity difference scores
puberty_reactivity <- all_difference |>
  left_join(
    sos_puberty |>
      mutate(PUBcomp_c = PUBcomp - mean(PUBcomp, na.rm = TRUE)),
    by = "SampleID"
  )

# puberty_vars = pubertal status measure from SOS-pubcomp.csv; puberty_labels
# gives the display name for it, keyed by variable name (parallels timing_labels)
puberty_vars      <- c("PUBcomp")
puberty_label_map <- c(PUBcomp = "Pubertal Status (Composite)")
puberty_labels    <- unname(puberty_label_map[puberty_vars])

# Timing variables (defined here so they are available for the combined matrix below)
timing_vars   <- c("age_menarche_c", "PDS_F5")
timing_labels <- c("Age at menarche (centered, years)",
                   "PDS F5: perceived timing (1=much earlier, 5=much later)")
timing_reactivity  <- all_difference |>
  left_join(timing_df, by = "SampleID")

reactivity_vars <- c(
  "task_rs_hr_diff", "conn_dis_hr_diff", "conn_other_hr_diff", "conn_rest_hr_diff",
  "crp_difference", "il10_difference", "il6_difference", "tnfa_difference",
  "dhea_difference", "test_difference", "cort_difference",
  "subj_scsd_difference", "subj_scother_difference"
)

reactivity_labels <- c(
  "ΔHR: Task vs. Rest", "ΔHR: SC vs. SD", "ΔHR: SC vs. Other", "ΔHR: SC vs. Fixation-Cross",
  "ΔCRP", "ΔIL-10", "ΔIL-6", "ΔTNF-α", "ΔDHEA", "ΔTestosterone", "ΔCortisol",
  "ΔSubj Stress: SC vs. SD", "ΔSubj Stress: SC vs. Other"
)
```

## Puberty Descriptives

```{r puberty-descriptives}
sos_puberty |>
  select(-SampleID) |>
  summarise(across(everything(), list(
    Mean = \(x) round(mean(x, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    SD   = \(x) round(sd(x,   na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    Min  = \(x) round(min(x,  na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    Max  = \(x) round(max(x,  na.rm = TRUE), 2),

  ))) |>

  pivot_wider(names_from = stat, values_from = value) |>

## Correlations: All Puberty Variables × Reactivity

Rows include pubertal status (PDS+line drawings composite), age at menarche, and PDS F5 perceived timing; columns are all reactivity outcomes.

```{r all-puberty-corr-matrix, fig.width=14, fig.height=5}
all_pub_vars   <- c(puberty_vars, timing_vars)
all_pub_labels <- c(puberty_labels, timing_labels)

all_pub_mat <- timing_reactivity |>
  select(all_of(c(all_pub_vars, reactivity_vars))) |>
  as.matrix()
colnames(all_pub_mat) <- c(all_pub_labels, reactivity_labels)

all_pub_corrs   <- rcorr(all_pub_mat)
pub_react_corrs <- all_pub_corrs   # alias for downstream inline text

# FDR computed HERE so corrplot and table use identical p-values.
# Each puberty/timing variable is its own family, corrected separately within
# each reactivity domain (e.g. PUBcomp x HR is one family, PUBcomp x hormones
# is a separate family, age at menarche x HR is yet another separate family).
hr_cols   <- reactivity_labels[1:4]
imm_cols  <- reactivity_labels[5:8]
horm_cols <- reactivity_labels[9:11]
subj_cols <- reactivity_labels[12:13]

raw_allpub_mat <- all_pub_corrs$P[all_pub_labels, reactivity_labels, drop = FALSE]
fdr_allpub_mat <- raw_allpub_mat
for (pv in all_pub_labels) {
  for (cols in list(hr_cols, imm_cols, horm_cols, subj_cols)) {
    fdr_allpub_mat[pv, cols] <- p.adjust(raw_allpub_mat[pv, cols], method = "fdr")
  }
}

# X marks reflect FDR-corrected significance (matches the table below)
plot_sig_corrplot(
  all_pub_corrs$r[all_pub_labels, reactivity_labels, drop = FALSE],
  fdr_allpub_mat,
  type = "full", cl.ratio = 0.06, cl.cex = 1.1,
  tl.cex = 0.95, mar = c(0, 0, 1, 6), diag = TRUE
)
```

*X marks indicate non-significant correlations after FDR correction (p~FDR~ ≥ .05). FDR applied separately for each puberty/timing variable, within each reactivity domain.*

## Correlation p-values: All Puberty Variables × Reactivity

```{r all-puberty-corr-pvalues}
# fdr_allpub_mat already computed in all-puberty-corr-matrix chunk above
fdr_allpub_mat |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  mutate(across(everything(), \(x) {
    sig  <- !is.na(x) & x < 0.05
    xlab <- if_else(is.na(x), "—", as.character(round(x, 4)))
    cell_spec(xlab, bold = sig, color = if_else(sig, "#2166ac", "black"))
  })) |>
  kable(escape = FALSE,
        caption = "FDR-adjusted p-values: all puberty variables × reactivity (bold = p_FDR < .05)") |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "hover")
```

```{r all-puberty-results-vals, echo=FALSE, include=FALSE}
sig_allpub <- expand.grid(pv = all_pub_labels, rv = reactivity_labels,
                          stringsAsFactors = FALSE) |>
  rowwise() |>
  mutate(
    r     = round(r_mat[pv, rv], 3),
    p_fdr = round(fdr_allpub_mat[pv, rv], 4),
    sig   = !is.na(p_fdr) & p_fdr < 0.05,
    label = paste0(pv, " × ", rv, " (r = ", r, ", p~FDR~ = ", p_fdr, ")")

  paste(sig_allpub$label, collapse = "; ")

# Describe direction only when every significant pair shares one sign and outcome,
# so the prose stays accurate if the underlying data/results change on re-render.
allpub_dir_text <- ""
if (n_sig_allpub > 0) {
  same_outcome <- n_distinct(sig_allpub$rv) == 1
  same_sign    <- n_distinct(sign(sig_allpub$r)) == 1
  if (same_outcome && same_sign) {
    dir_word <- if (unique(sign(sig_allpub$r)) > 0) "greater" else "smaller"
    allpub_dir_text <- paste0(
      " All significant associations involved ", unique(sig_allpub$rv),
      ", such that higher values on these puberty/timing variables were associated with ",
      dir_word, " reactivity on this outcome."
    )
  }
}

## Puberty Status as Predictor of Reactivity

Simple regressions: reactivity ~ pubertal status (mean-centered).

```{r puberty-regressions, results='asis'}
pv_c <- paste0(puberty_vars, "_c")   # centered counterparts

for (i in seq_along(puberty_vars)) {
  pv  <- puberty_vars[i]
  pvc <- pv_c[i]
  cat("\n\n###", puberty_labels[i], "(centered)\n\n")
  reg_tbl <- map_dfr(setNames(reactivity_vars, reactivity_labels), function(rv) {
    dat <- puberty_reactivity |> select(all_of(c(rv, pvc))) |> na.omit()
    if (nrow(dat) < 5) return(NULL)
    fit <- lm(as.formula(paste(rv, "~", pvc)), data = dat)
    broom::tidy(fit) |>
      filter(term != "(Intercept)") |>
      mutate(term = pv, outcome = rv, .before = 1)
  }, .id = "Reactivity") |>
    select(Reactivity, estimate, std.error, statistic, p.value) |>
    mutate(p_fdr = round(p.adjust(p.value, method = "fdr"), 4)) |>
    mutate(across(c(estimate, std.error, statistic), \(x) round(x, 3))) |>
    mutate(p.value = round(p.value, 4))

  reg_tbl |>
    mutate(
      p.value = as.character(p.value),
      p_fdr   = cell_spec(p_fdr, bold = !is.na(p_fdr) & p_fdr < 0.05,
        color = if_else(!is.na(p_fdr) & p_fdr < 0.05, "#2166ac", "black"))
    ) |>
    kable(escape = FALSE,
          col.names = c("Reactivity outcome", "b", "SE", "t", "p (raw)", "p (FDR)")) |>
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "hover", full_width = FALSE) |>
    print()
}
```

# Hypothesis 2 (continued): Pubertal Timing and Reactivity

Pubertal timing is operationalized here as (1) **age at menarche** (lower = earlier onset), (2) perceived pubertal timing as reported on the PDS, and (3) the regression below enters centered pubertal status (PUBcomp) and centered age simultaneously, so each coefficient controls for the other.

```{r timing-processing, echo=FALSE}
# timing_reactivity, timing_vars, timing_labels defined in puberty-processing chunk
```

## Descriptives

```{r timing-descriptives}
timing_df |>
  select(age_at_session, PUBcomp, PDS_F5, age_menarche) |>
  psych::describe() |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  select(n, mean, sd, min, max, skew, kurtosis) |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 2))) |>
  tibble::rownames_to_column("Variable") |>
  mutate(Variable = recode(Variable,
    age_at_session   = "Age at session (years)",
    PUBcomp          = "Pubertal status (Composite)",
    PDS_F5 = "Perceived Pubertal Timing",
    age_menarche     = "Age at menarche (years)"
  )) |>
  kable(caption = "Pubertal timing descriptives") |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "hover", full_width = FALSE)
```

## Correlations: Timing × Reactivity

*See combined puberty correlation matrix above for age-at-menarche and PDS F5 correlations with all reactivity outcomes.*

## Timing as Predictor of Reactivity

Each reactivity outcome is regressed on centered pubertal status (PUBcomp) and centered age (`age_at_session_c`) simultaneously. The status coefficient reflects status beyond what is expected for age (early timing); the `age_at_session_c` coefficient reflects age beyond what is expected for status.

```{r timing-regressions, results='asis'}
timing_joint_tbl <- map_dfr(seq_along(puberty_vars), function(i) {
  pv       <- puberty_vars[i]
  pvc      <- paste0(pv, "_c")
  pv_label <- puberty_labels[i]

  map_dfr(setNames(reactivity_vars, reactivity_labels), function(rv) {
    dat <- timing_reactivity |>
      select(all_of(c(rv, pvc, "age_at_session_c"))) |>
      na.omit()
    if (nrow(dat) < 5) return(NULL)
    fit <- lm(as.formula(paste(rv, "~", pvc, "+ age_at_session_c")), data = dat)
    broom::tidy(fit) |>
      filter(term != "(Intercept)") |>
      mutate(
        term = if_else(term == pvc,
                        paste0(pv_label, " (centered)"),
                        "Age at session (centered)"),
        across(c(estimate, std.error, statistic), \(x) round(x, 3)),
        p.value = round(p.value, 4)
      )
  }, .id = "Reactivity") |>
    mutate(measure = pv_label, .before = 1)
}) |>
  group_by(measure, term) |>
  mutate(p_fdr = round(p.adjust(p.value, method = "fdr"), 4)) |>
  ungroup()

for (ms in unique(timing_joint_tbl$measure)) {
  cat("\n\n###", ms, "\n\n")
  for (trm in unique(timing_joint_tbl$term[timing_joint_tbl$measure == ms])) {
    cat("\n\n####", trm, "\n\n")
    timing_joint_tbl |>
      filter(measure == ms, term == trm) |>
      select(Reactivity, estimate, std.error, statistic, p.value, p_fdr) |>
      mutate(p_fdr = cell_spec(p_fdr, bold = !is.na(p_fdr) & p_fdr < 0.05,
        color = if_else(!is.na(p_fdr) & p_fdr < 0.05, "#2166ac", "black"))) |>
      kable(escape = FALSE,
            col.names = c("Reactivity outcome", "b", "SE", "t", "p (raw)", "p (FDR)"),
            caption = paste("Reactivity ~", trm, "+ other term (both centered); FDR within measure × term")) |>
      kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "hover", full_width = FALSE) |>
      print()
  }
}
```

```{r timing-results-vals, echo=FALSE, include=FALSE}
fmt_timing_sig <- function(df) {
  if (nrow(df) == 0) return("none reached statistical significance after FDR correction")
  paste(
    paste0(df$Reactivity, " (*b* = ", df$estimate, ", *p*~FDR~ = ", df$p_fdr, ")"),
    collapse = "; "
  )
}

timing_summary <- lapply(puberty_labels, function(pv_label) {
  status_term <- paste0(pv_label, " (centered)")
  sig_status  <- timing_joint_tbl |> filter(measure == pv_label, term == status_term, p_fdr < 0.05)
  sig_age     <- timing_joint_tbl |> filter(measure == pv_label, term == "Age at session (centered)", p_fdr < 0.05)
  list(
    label       = pv_label,
    n_status    = nrow(sig_status), status_text = fmt_timing_sig(sig_status),
    n_age       = nrow(sig_age),    age_text    = fmt_timing_sig(sig_age)
  )
})

timing_results_paragraph <- paste(sapply(timing_summary, function(s) {
  paste0(
    "For ", s$label, ", ", s$n_status,
    " outcome", if (s$n_status != 1) "s" else "", " showed a significant status-beyond-age effect (",
    s$status_text, "), and ", s$n_age,
    " outcome", if (s$n_age != 1) "s" else "", " showed a significant age-beyond-status effect (",
    s$age_text, ")."
  )
}), collapse = " ")
```

**Results.** To disentangle pubertal status from chronological age, each reactivity outcome was regressed simultaneously on mean-centered pubertal status (PDS+line drawings composite) and mean-centered age at session (`age_at_session_c`). The status coefficient reflects status beyond that expected for age (i.e., early maturation); the `age_at_session_c` coefficient reflects age beyond that expected for status. After FDR correction within each predictor term across all 13 reactivity outcomes: `r timing_results_paragraph` Scatter plots of timing predictors against biomarker reactivity outcomes are shown below.

## Forest Plot: Effect of Pubertal Status Controlling for Age

Effect of pubertal status (PUBcomp, centered) on each reactivity outcome, from the joint model above (`reactivity ~ pubertal status + age at session`, both centered). Points are the status coefficient; bars are 95% CI; blue marks FDR-significant effects (*p*~FDR~ < .05).

```{r timing-status-forest, fig.width=10, fig.height=6.5}
# Greek letters (Delta, beta) built via intToUtf8() and re-tagged as UTF-8
# rather than relying on the literal characters already in reactivity_labels
# surviving whatever locale this renders under -- under a "C" locale, R's
# text-rendering path (ggplot/grid) can misread genuinely-correct UTF-8 bytes
# tagged Encoding="unknown" as single-byte junk, even though e.g. a kable/HTML
# table of the same strings displays fine (browser text isn't subject to
# this). Cheap insurance either way.
delta_sym <- intToUtf8(916)
beta_sym  <- intToUtf8(946)
cardio_domain_label <- paste0("Cardiovascular (", delta_sym, "HR)")

status_term_label <- paste0(puberty_labels[1], " (centered)")

forest_dat <- timing_joint_tbl |>
  filter(term == status_term_label) |>
  mutate(Reactivity = {x <- Reactivity; Encoding(x) <- "UTF-8"; x}) |>
  mutate(
    domain = case_when(
      grepl("^.HR:", Reactivity) ~ cardio_domain_label,
      grepl("Subj Stress", Reactivity) ~ "Subjective Stress",
      TRUE ~ "Biomarkers"
    ),
    domain = factor(domain, levels = c(cardio_domain_label, "Biomarkers", "Subjective Stress")),
    sig    = ifelse(p_fdr < 0.05, "FDR-significant (p < .05)", "Not significant"),
    ci_lo  = estimate - 1.96 * std.error,
    ci_hi  = estimate + 1.96 * std.error,
    Reactivity = factor(Reactivity, levels = rev({x <- reactivity_labels; Encoding(x) <- "UTF-8"; x}))
  )

ggplot(forest_dat, aes(x = estimate, y = Reactivity, color = sig)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.5, color = "grey45") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = ci_lo, xmax = ci_hi), width = 0, linewidth = 0.7, orientation = "y") +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  facet_grid(rows = vars(domain), scales = "free_y", space = "free_y", switch = "y") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("FDR-significant (p < .05)" = "#2a78d6", "Not significant" = "#b9b8b2")) +
  labs(
    x = paste0("Effect of pubertal status on reactivity (", beta_sym, ", controlling for age)"),
    y = NULL,
    color = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    strip.placement = "outside",
    strip.text.y.left = element_text(angle = 0, face = "bold", hjust = 0),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )
```

## Trend Plot: Age-Adjusted Effect of Pubertal Status on Reactivity

The forest plot above shows the size of the age-adjusted pubertal-status effect; this shows the trend itself. Each panel is a **partial-residual (added-variable) plot**: both pubertal status and the reactivity outcome are first residualized on age at session, then plotted against each other. The slope of the fitted line in each panel is mathematically identical to that outcome's status coefficient in the joint model above -- this is what that coefficient looks like as a scatter of actual data rather than a single point estimate.

```{r timing-status-trend, fig.width=13, fig.height=9}
status_sig <- timing_joint_tbl |>
  filter(term == status_term_label) |>
  select(Reactivity, p_fdr) |>
  mutate(sig = ifelse(p_fdr < 0.05, "FDR-significant (p < .05)", "Not significant"))

react_partial <- map_dfr(setNames(reactivity_vars, reactivity_labels), function(rv) {
  dat <- timing_reactivity |>
    select(all_of(c(rv, "PUBcomp", "age_at_session"))) |>
    na.omit()
  if (nrow(dat) < 5) return(NULL)
  resid_y <- resid(lm(as.formula(paste(rv, "~ age_at_session")), data = dat))
  resid_x <- resid(lm(PUBcomp ~ age_at_session, data = dat))
  tibble(resid_status = resid_x, resid_outcome = resid_y)
}, .id = "Reactivity") |>
  left_join(status_sig, by = "Reactivity") |>
  mutate(
    domain = case_when(
      grepl("^.HR:", Reactivity) ~ cardio_domain_label,
      grepl("Subj Stress", Reactivity) ~ "Subjective Stress",
      TRUE ~ "Biomarkers"
    ),
    domain = factor(domain, levels = c(cardio_domain_label, "Biomarkers", "Subjective Stress")),
    Reactivity = {x <- Reactivity; Encoding(x) <- "UTF-8"; x},
    Reactivity = factor(Reactivity, levels = {x <- reactivity_labels; Encoding(x) <- "UTF-8"; x})
  )

ggplot(react_partial, aes(x = resid_status, y = resid_outcome)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey70", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey70", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5, size = 1.5, color = "grey30") +
  geom_smooth(aes(color = sig, fill = sig), method = "lm", formula = y ~ x, se = TRUE, linewidth = 0.9, alpha = 0.15) +
  facet_wrap(~Reactivity, scales = "free", ncol = 4) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("FDR-significant (p < .05)" = "#2a78d6", "Not significant" = "#b9b8b2"), drop = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("FDR-significant (p < .05)" = "#2a78d6", "Not significant" = "#b9b8b2"), drop = FALSE) +
  labs(
    x = "Pubertal status (residualized on age)",
    y = "Reactivity (residualized on age)",
    color = NULL, fill = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", strip.text = element_text(size = 8))
```

### Trend Plot: Significant Relationships Only

Same partial-residual plots as above, restricted to the `r sum(status_sig$sig == "FDR-significant (p < .05)")` outcomes that survived FDR correction -- a cleaner figure for highlighting just the significant status-beyond-age effects.

ggplot(react_partial_sig, aes(x = resid_status, y = resid_outcome)) +

  geom_point(alpha = 0.5, size = 1.5, color = "grey30") +

  facet_wrap(~Reactivity, scales = "free", ncol = 4) +
  labs(
    x = "Pubertal status (residualized on age)",
    y = "Reactivity (residualized on age)"
  ) +

```

## Correlation Matrix: Pubertal Timing, Age, and Psychosocial Predictors

Intercorrelations among the individual-difference predictors used across the puberty and psychosocial hypotheses: pubertal status (PUBcomp composite), age at menarche, perceived pubertal timing (PDS F5), age at session, BFNES (fear of negative evaluation), and CES-DC (depressive symptoms). This is not a predictor-vs-reactivity matrix (those are reported separately above and in Hypothesis 3 below) -- it's the relationships among the predictors themselves, useful for spotting overlap/multicollinearity before interpreting single-predictor models one at a time.

```{r predictors-corr-matrix, fig.width=9, fig.height=8}
predictors_df <- timing_df |>
  select(SampleID, PUBcomp, age_menarche, PDS_F5, age_at_session) |>
  left_join(bfnes, by = "SampleID") |>
  left_join(dep, by = "SampleID")

predictors_matrix <- predictors_df |> select(-SampleID) |> as.matrix()
colnames(predictors_matrix) <- c(
  "Pubertal Status (Composite)", "Age at Menarche", "Perceived Pubertal Timing (PDS F5)",
  "Age at Session", "BFNES (Fear of Negative Evaluation)", "CES-D (Depression)"
)

predictors_rcorrs <- rcorr(predictors_matrix)

# Single family of 15 pairwise tests (these 6 predictors don't split into the
# domain blocks the reactivity-outcome matrices use), FDR-corrected together.
predictors_fdr_mat <- predictors_rcorrs$P
ut <- upper.tri(predictors_fdr_mat)
predictors_fdr_mat[ut] <- p.adjust(predictors_fdr_mat[ut], method = "fdr")
predictors_fdr_mat[lower.tri(predictors_fdr_mat)] <- t(predictors_fdr_mat)[lower.tri(predictors_fdr_mat)]

plot_sig_corrplot(predictors_rcorrs$r, predictors_fdr_mat)
```

*Circle size and color reflect correlation magnitude (red = negative, blue = positive). X marks indicate non-significant correlations after FDR correction (p~FDR~ ≥ .05, applied across all 15 pairs). Sample sizes vary by pair due to missingness (age at menarche in particular, n = 53 vs. n = 74 for most other variables); `rcorr()` uses pairwise-complete observations.*

    sig  <- !is.na(x) & x < 0.05
    xlab <- if_else(is.na(x), "—", as.character(round(x, 4)))
    cell_spec(xlab, bold = sig, color = if_else(sig, "#2166ac", "black"))
  })) |>
  kable(escape = FALSE,
        caption = "P-values FDR-corrected across all 15 predictor pairs (bold = p_FDR < .05).") |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "hover")

## Scatter Plots: Timing × Biomarker Reactivity

```{r timing-reactivity-scatter, results='asis', fig.width=10, fig.height=5}
bio_react_vars   <- names(bio_react_labels)

for (tv in timing_vars) {
  tv_label <- timing_labels[which(timing_vars == tv)]
  cat("\n\n###", tv_label, "\n\n")

  pdat <- timing_reactivity |>
    select(all_of(c(tv, bio_react_vars))) |>
    pivot_longer(-all_of(tv), names_to = "biomarker", values_to = "reactivity") |>
    mutate(biomarker = factor(biomarker, levels = bio_react_vars,
                              labels = unname(bio_react_labels)))

  p <- ggplot(pdat, aes(x = .data[[tv]], y = reactivity)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.35, size = 1.5) +
    geom_smooth(method = "loess", formula = y ~ x, se = TRUE,
                color = "#440154FF", fill = "#440154FF", alpha = 0.15, linewidth = 0.9) +
    facet_wrap(~biomarker, nrow = 2, scales = "free_y") +
    labs(x = tv_label, y = "Reactivity (peak − T1, log scale)") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 10)
  print(p)
}
```

# Hypothesis 2: Puberty and Raw Biomarker Levels

Correlations between pubertal development and raw biomarker levels at each timepoint (T1–T4).

```{r puberty-raw-levels, echo=FALSE}
biomarker_levels <- sos_crp_panel |>
  full_join(sos_cytokines_panel, by = c("SampleID", "Time")) |>
  full_join(sos_hormones_panel,  by = c("SampleID", "Time")) |>
  left_join(sos_puberty,         by = "SampleID")
```

```{r puberty-levels-corr, results='asis'}
for (pv in puberty_vars) {
  cat("\n\n##", puberty_label_map[[pv]], "\n\n")
  bio_vars <- c("CRP_log", "IL10_log", "IL6_log", "TNFalpha_log",
                "DHEA_log", "Testosterone_log", "Cortisol_log")

  corr_long <- map_dfr(bio_vars, function(bv) {
    map_dfr(1:4, function(tp) {
      dat <- biomarker_levels |>
        filter(Time == tp) |>
        select(all_of(c(bv, pv))) |>
        na.omit()
      if (nrow(dat) < 5) return(NULL)
      ct <- cor.test(dat[[bv]], dat[[pv]])
      tibble(
        Biomarker = bv,
        Timepoint = paste0("T", tp),
        r         = round(unname(ct$estimate), 3),
        p_raw     = ct$p.value
      )
    })
  }) |>
    mutate(group = if_else(
      Biomarker %in% c("CRP_log", "IL10_log", "IL6_log", "TNFalpha_log"),
      "Immune", "Hormones"
    )) |>
    group_by(group) |>
    mutate(p_fdr = round(p.adjust(p_raw, method = "fdr"), 4)) |>
    ungroup()

  corr_tbl <- corr_long |>
    pivot_wider(id_cols = Biomarker, names_from = Timepoint,
                values_from = c(r, p_fdr),
                names_glue = "{Timepoint}_{.value}") |>
    select(Biomarker, T1_r, T1_p_fdr, T2_r, T2_p_fdr, T3_r, T3_p_fdr, T4_r, T4_p_fdr)

  corr_tbl |>
    mutate(across(ends_with("_p_fdr"), \(x) cell_spec(
      round(x, 4), bold = !is.na(x) & x < 0.05,
      color = if_else(!is.na(x) & x < 0.05, "#2166ac", "black")
    ))) |>
    kable(format = "html", escape = FALSE,
          col.names = c("Biomarker", "r", "p (FDR)", "r", "p (FDR)", "r", "p (FDR)", "r", "p (FDR)"),
          caption   = paste0("Correlations: ", puberty_label_map[[pv]],
                             " ", intToUtf8(215), " biomarker levels (FDR-adjusted within immune/hormones; bold = p_FDR < .05)")) |>
    add_header_above(c(" " = 1, "T1" = 2, "T2" = 2, "T3" = 2, "T4" = 2)) |>
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "hover", full_width = FALSE) |>
    as.character() |>
    cat()
}
```

## Age-Adjusted Effect of Pubertal Status on Raw Biomarker Levels

The correlations above are unadjusted (pubertal status alone). Here each log-transformed biomarker level, at each timepoint, is regressed jointly on pubertal status (PUBcomp) and age at session, isolating the status-beyond-age effect the same way the reactivity models above do.

```{r puberty-levels-regressions}
biomarker_levels <- biomarker_levels |> left_join(age_df, by = "SampleID")

bio_vars_log    <- c("CRP_log", "IL10_log", "IL6_log", "TNFalpha_log", "DHEA_log", "Testosterone_log", "Cortisol_log")
bio_labels_map  <- setNames(
  c("CRP", "IL-10", "IL-6", paste0("TNF-", intToUtf8(945)), "DHEA", "Testosterone", "Cortisol"),
  bio_vars_log
)

levels_joint_tbl <- map_dfr(bio_vars_log, function(bv) {
  map_dfr(1:4, function(tp) {
    dat <- biomarker_levels |>
      filter(Time == tp) |>
      select(all_of(c(bv, "PUBcomp", "age_at_session"))) |>
      na.omit()
    if (nrow(dat) < 5) return(NULL)
    fit <- lm(as.formula(paste(bv, "~ PUBcomp + age_at_session")), data = dat)
    broom::tidy(fit) |>
      filter(term == "PUBcomp") |>
      mutate(Biomarker = bio_labels_map[bv], Timepoint = paste0("T", tp), n = nrow(dat))
  })
}) |>
  mutate(group = if_else(Biomarker %in% c("CRP", "IL-10", "IL-6", paste0("TNF-", intToUtf8(945))), "Immune", "Hormones")) |>
  group_by(group) |>
  mutate(p_fdr = round(p.adjust(p.value, method = "fdr"), 4)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(estimate = round(estimate, 3))

levels_joint_tbl |>
  pivot_wider(id_cols = Biomarker, names_from = Timepoint, values_from = c(estimate, p_fdr),
              names_glue = "{Timepoint}_{.value}") |>
  select(Biomarker, T1_estimate, T1_p_fdr, T2_estimate, T2_p_fdr, T3_estimate, T3_p_fdr, T4_estimate, T4_p_fdr) |>
  mutate(across(ends_with("_p_fdr"), \(x) cell_spec(
    x, bold = !is.na(x) & x < 0.05, color = if_else(!is.na(x) & x < 0.05, "#2166ac", "black")
  ))) |>
  kable(format = "html", escape = FALSE,
        col.names = c("Biomarker", "b", "p (FDR)", "b", "p (FDR)", "b", "p (FDR)", "b", "p (FDR)"),
        caption = "Effect of pubertal status on log biomarker level, controlling for age (FDR within immune/hormones; bold = p_FDR < .05)") |>
  add_header_above(c(" " = 1, "T1" = 2, "T2" = 2, "T3" = 2, "T4" = 2)) |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "hover", full_width = FALSE)
```

### Trend Plot: Age-Adjusted Effect of Pubertal Status on Raw Biomarker Levels

Same partial-residual approach as the reactivity trend plot above -- both pubertal status and each biomarker level are residualized on age at session (separately per timepoint), then plotted against each other. Rows are biomarkers, columns are timepoints (T1–T4).

```{r puberty-levels-trend, fig.width=11, fig.height=12}
levels_sig <- levels_joint_tbl |>
  mutate(sig = ifelse(p_fdr < 0.05, "FDR-significant (p < .05)", "Not significant")) |>
  select(Biomarker, Timepoint, sig)

levels_partial <- map_dfr(bio_vars_log, function(bv) {
  map_dfr(1:4, function(tp) {
    dat <- biomarker_levels |>
      filter(Time == tp) |>
      select(all_of(c(bv, "PUBcomp", "age_at_session"))) |>
      na.omit()
    if (nrow(dat) < 5) return(NULL)
    resid_y <- resid(lm(as.formula(paste(bv, "~ age_at_session")), data = dat))
    resid_x <- resid(lm(PUBcomp ~ age_at_session, data = dat))
    tibble(Biomarker = bio_labels_map[bv], Timepoint = paste0("T", tp), resid_status = resid_x, resid_level = resid_y)
  })
}) |>
  left_join(levels_sig, by = c("Biomarker", "Timepoint")) |>
  mutate(
    Biomarker = factor(Biomarker, levels = unname(bio_labels_map)),
    Timepoint = factor(Timepoint, levels = paste0("T", 1:4))
  )

ggplot(levels_partial, aes(x = resid_status, y = resid_level)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey70", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey70", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.4, size = 1.2, color = "grey30") +
  geom_smooth(aes(color = sig, fill = sig), method = "lm", formula = y ~ x, se = TRUE, linewidth = 0.8, alpha = 0.15) +
  facet_grid(Biomarker ~ Timepoint, scales = "free") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("FDR-significant (p < .05)" = "#2a78d6", "Not significant" = "#b9b8b2"), drop = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("FDR-significant (p < .05)" = "#2a78d6", "Not significant" = "#b9b8b2"), drop = FALSE) +
  labs(
    x = "Pubertal status (residualized on age)",
    y = "Log biomarker level (residualized on age)",
    color = NULL, fill = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0), strip.text = element_text(size = 8))
```

# Hypothesis 3a: Depression and Biomarker Correlations

*Hypothesis 3 (manuscript): Pearson correlations between CES-DC total score and (a) log-transformed biomarker concentrations at each of the four timepoints (T1–T4), FDR-corrected separately within immune markers and hormones, and (b) each of the 13 reactivity difference scores, FDR-corrected within each reactivity domain.*

```{r dep-desc}
dep |>
  summarise(
    n    = sum(!is.na(CESD_total)),
    Mean = round(mean(CESD_total, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    SD   = round(sd(CESD_total,   na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    Min  = round(min(CESD_total,  na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    Max  = round(max(CESD_total,  na.rm = TRUE), 2)
  ) |>

```

  ))) |>

```

```{r dep-levels-results-vals, echo=FALSE, include=FALSE}

FDR correction was applied separately within immune markers (CRP, IL-10, IL-6, TNF-α) and hormones (DHEA, Testosterone, Cortisol). `r if (n_sig_dep_levels == 0) "No significant associations survived FDR correction." else paste0(n_sig_dep_levels, " significant association", if (n_sig_dep_levels != 1) "s were" else " was", " observed: ", dep_levels_sig_text, ".")`

```{r dep-reactivity-corr}

# Hypothesis 3b: BFNES and Biomarker Correlations

Correlations between BFNES (Brief Fear of Negative Evaluation Scale; Leary, 1983) total score and biomarker levels at each timepoint and biomarker reactivity. Items 2, 6, 7, and 10 were reverse-scored; total scores range from 12–60 with higher scores reflecting greater fear of negative evaluation.

```{r covariate-load, echo=FALSE}
# Illness/medications/oral-health/smoking covariate descriptives and the
# flow-rate/covariate-adjusted sensitivity models that used to live here have
# moved to sos-bioreactivity-supplement.qmd. Only the covariates still used by
# the Sample Timing and Correlation Matrices sections below (bmi, wake_time,
# saliva_timing, static_covariates) remain here.

# BMI: ID column → SampleID; recode SOS068/SOS076 → TAG068/TAG076
bmi <- read.csv(file.path(
  data_path,
  "SOS/SOS-study-monash/sos-bmi.csv"
)) |>
  rename(SampleID = 1) |>
  mutate(SampleID = case_when(
    SampleID == "SOS068" ~ "TAG068",
    SampleID == "SOS076" ~ "TAG076",
    .default = SampleID
  ))

# Sample timing: parse HH:MM → minutes since midnight; compute elapsed from T1
parse_hhmm <- function(x) {
  x     <- trimws(x)
  parts <- strsplit(x, ":")
  hrs   <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(sapply(parts, `[`, 1)))
  mins  <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(sapply(parts, function(p) if (length(p) >= 2) p[2] else "0")))
  mins[is.na(mins)] <- 0
  ifelse(nzchar(x) & !is.na(hrs), hrs * 60 + mins, NA_real_)
}

saliva_timing <- sos_saliva_times |>
  rename(SampleID = TAG.ID) |>
  mutate(
    SampleID = case_when(
      SampleID == "SOS068" ~ "TAG068",
      SampleID == "SOS076" ~ "TAG076",
      .default = SampleID
    ),
    t1_min = parse_hhmm(X1i_start),
    t2_min = parse_hhmm(X2i_start),
    t3_min = parse_hhmm(X3i_start),
    t4_min = parse_hhmm(X4i_start),
    elapsed_T2 = t2_min - t1_min,
    elapsed_T3 = t3_min - t1_min,
    elapsed_T4 = t4_min - t1_min
  ) |>
  select(SampleID, t1_min, elapsed_T2, elapsed_T3, elapsed_T4)

# Wake time × hormones: parse free-text wake time; join to T1 start time
parse_wake <- function(x) {
  x <- trimws(tolower(x))
  x <- gsub("\\s+", " ", x)
  pm <- grepl("pm", x)
  x  <- gsub("[^0-9:]", "", x)
  parts <- strsplit(x, ":")
  hrs   <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(sapply(parts, `[`, 1)))
  mins  <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(sapply(parts, function(p) if (length(p) >= 2) p[2] else "0")))
  mins[is.na(mins)] <- 0
  hrs[pm & hrs < 12] <- hrs[pm & hrs < 12] + 12
  ifelse(is.na(hrs), NA_real_, hrs * 60 + mins)
}

wake_time <- sos_session_runner |>
  select(saliva_1, saliva_2) |>
  setNames(c("SampleID", "wake_raw")) |>
  filter(grepl("^(TAG|SOS)\\d{3}", SampleID)) |>
  mutate(
    SampleID = sub("^SOS", "TAG", SampleID),
    wake_min = parse_wake(wake_raw),
    wake_min = ifelse(wake_min > 840, NA_real_, wake_min)  # exclude implausible (>2pm)
  ) |>
  select(SampleID, wake_min) |>
  left_join(saliva_timing |> select(SampleID, t1_min), by = "SampleID") |>
  mutate(
    hours_since_wake = (t1_min - wake_min) / 60
  )

# Static (person-level) covariates shared across trend and reactivity checks.
# age_df comes from the Hypothesis 2 puberty-load chunk (already computed,
# since that section runs earlier in the document).
static_covariates <- age_df |>
  left_join(bmi       |> select(SampleID, BMI),               by = "SampleID") |>
  left_join(wake_time  |> select(SampleID, hours_since_wake),  by = "SampleID")
```
